name: Sacred City of Caral-Supe
description: Rising from a dry desert terrace above the green Supe River valley, about 182 km north of Lima, Caral is the oldest known city in the Americas. Around 5,000 years ago its people raised six huge stone-and-earth pyramids and sunken circular plazas. A knotted-string quipu found here hints at how this early society kept its records.
